career_ladder.note: Tubewell Operator (Nalkoop Chalak) operates and maintains state government deep tube wells, canal pumps, and minor irrigation electrical machinery under the Irrigation and Water Resources Department (Sinchai Evam Jal Sansadhan Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh. Technical candidates possessing ITI certifications enter at Pay Level 2 and progress through technical supervisory cadres.

exam_scheme.note: Selection consists of an objective written examination testing technical trade knowledge alongside general Hindi and general knowledge, followed by document verification of High School and National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI) credentials. Negative marking of 0.25 (1/4th) is applied per incorrect answer.

financial_package.note: Tubewell Operator is placed in Pay Level 2 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹1,900) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Irrigation & Water Resources Department & UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 2
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 2 entry basic pay of ₹19,900 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹1,600 to ₹3,200 based on rural/tehsil posting), night operational allowance where applicable, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,144) and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or irrigation staff quarter at pump canal station
Field equipment and technical maintenance allowance
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Leave travel concession (LTC) and festival advance entitlements
